meta.title: Dymcode — bug reports and feedback in Telegram & Discord
meta.description: A 9 KB feedback widget with screenshots. Reports land in Telegram or Discord instantly. Free to start.

landing.heroTitle: Bug reports and feedback, straight to Telegram & Discord
landing.heroBody: Add one script tag. Visitors send a message with a screenshot and page context; you get it in your chat within seconds.
landing.step1: Create a project and paste the snippet into your site.
landing.step2: Connect Telegram or Discord in one click.
landing.step3: Get every report with a screenshot, browser and console errors.
landing.tryIt: Try it: the button in the corner is the real widget.
landing.whySize: Tiny: about 9 KB gzipped, screenshots load only when needed.
landing.whyInstant: Instant alerts where your team already is.
landing.whyPrivacy: Private by design: passwords are masked in screenshots, tokens are redacted.
landing.whyPrice: Fair price: free to start, $9/month or $49 once for Pro.
landing.planFreeBody: 1 project · 20 reports/month · Telegram & Discord alerts · 30-day screenshots
landing.planProBody: Unlimited projects and reports · your own bot · no badge · custom CSS · 1-year screenshots
landing.faq1q: Will it slow down my site?
landing.faq1a: No. The script loads async and starts when the browser is idle.
landing.faq2q: What happens over the Free limit?
landing.faq2a: Reports are still saved; upgrade to see them.
landing.faq3q: Can I use my own button?
landing.faq3a: Yes: hide ours with data-hide-trigger and call Dymcode.open().

legal.privacy1: Dymcode stores what a visitor submits through the widget: the message, an optional email and an optional screenshot.
legal.privacy2: With each report we store page metadata: URL (tokens in query strings are redacted), browser, OS, screen and viewport size, language, time zone and recent console errors.
legal.privacy3: Screenshots are kept for 30 days on Free and 365 days on Pro, then deleted automatically.
legal.privacy4: IP addresses are never stored; only a salted hash is used inside short-lived rate-limit keys.
legal.privacy5: Reports are delivered to the Telegram or Discord destinations the project owner configures.
legal.privacy6: Account owners can delete projects or their whole account at any time; this removes all related data.
legal.terms1: Dymcode is provided as is. Do not use it to collect data you are not allowed to collect.
legal.terms2: You are responsible for informing your site’s visitors about the widget in your own privacy policy.
legal.terms3: Free plan limits may change with notice. Paid plans renew monthly until cancelled; Lifetime is a one-time payment.
legal.terms4: We may suspend accounts that abuse the service or its delivery channels.
